definitions.name: O2D.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'O2D.C' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD O2D.C GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest nesting depth (max running count of open brackets, 0 for empty)

definitions.name: O2D.BALANCED-PREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN 'O2D.B' BIND [ '#' ] O2D.B CONCAT 'O2D.S' BIND O2D.S O1A.IDX 0 O2D.S [ '#' EQ ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of the longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is), via G0A.BSCAN

definitions.name: O2D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'O2D.V' BIND O2D.V O2D.V O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> same-length Vector, each NIL replaced by the nearest present value before it (leading NILs take the first present value)

definitions.name: O2D.LONGEST-GAP
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 when none)

definitions.name: O2D.UNPRICED
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> distinct skus of the orders without a price, in order of first appearance

definitions.name: O2D.TAG-COUNTS
definitions.body: [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it, tags in order of first appearance
